decided: The configuration guide describes the sign-off setting from the user's side: with change, each archive shows the saved brief and waits for the user to sign off or decline before anything is synced, and the review reads the account; absent or off, nothing waits; any other value is read as absent, with one line saying so.
alternatives: Describe only the values, leaving out the reading of the account.
Point the reader at the command reference instead of describing the effect.
why: A user turning the setting on needs to know both what will now stop and ask them and that the account they will read has been checked; the rest of that table describes each key by its effect in the same way.
detail: docs/customization.md (signoff row, key count nine, example, Carried-by line), docs/cli.md (signoff emit, --hold, decisions brief), docs/concepts.md Trail row, CLAUDE.md.
